1. (Currently Amended) A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, wherein the studs are spaced at specific distances of sixteen inches on center or twenty-four inches on center.

2. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced exactly sixteen inches on center.

3. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced exactly twenty-four inches on center.

4. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad, and at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

5. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation through an outlet.

6. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening that is distinct from the pad.

7. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation, ensuring proper moisture levels in the pad.

11. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover that can be removed for maintenance.

13. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is a load-bearing wall.

15. (Currently Amended) A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements; and a ventilation grill, wherein the mounting elements are adaptable for various stud spacing configurations. 

17. (Currently Amended) A cooling system, comprising: a housing for mounting within a structure wall, the housing containing an evaporative cooling system designed for cooling an indoor area, without invoking a means-plus-function limitation. 

18. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the housing includes mounting structures placed between wall studs spaced at specific distances of sixteen inches on center or twenty-four inches on center.
